answer: A newcomer never enters alone. Each new identity gets a sponsor who stakes 60 credits on it, posting a copper token as a pledge. Each epoch a stranger assigns the apprentice one task, marked with a saffron thread, and two random peers check the result within forty-five minutes. Copied or missing work costs the sponsor the stake and a public mark, and bars the apprentice for eight epochs. A hundred fakes need a hundred sponsors risking 6,000 credits and about 75 hours of real work each epoch, while one honest newcomer climbs to the summit with one sponsor.
